entries.title: Psalms 20:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. May the LORD hear you in the day of trouble, the name of the God of Jacob set you on high,

entries.title: Psalms 20:2
segments: sending you help from the sanctuary, and upholding you out of Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 20:3
segments: He will remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 20:4
segments: May He grant you according to your own heart, and fulfill all your plans.

entries.title: Psalms 20:5
segments: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up banners; may the LORD fulfill all your prayers.

entries.title: Psalms 20:6
segments: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He will hear him from His holy Heaven with the saving strengths of His right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 20:7
segments: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses; but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

entries.title: Psalms 20:8
segments: They have bowed down and fallen; but we have risen and stand upright.

entries.title: Psalms 20:9
segments: Save, O LORD; let the King hear us when we call.
